partnershipPlan: Two members of the maternity voices partnership review the interview guide for women; a booking clerk and a coordinator review the staff guide.
socialListening: No social media listening; the unit's complaints and compliments about induction from the last year are read in anonymised form.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: Nobody could tell me if it would be today or tomorrow, so I just sat there with my bag.
items.implication: Explore communication while waiting as a theme.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: At eight in the evening three inductions arrive and there is one of me for the whole corridor.
items.implication: Ask staff to walk through a surge shift in detail.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I fill the six slots; I have no idea what the labour ward will look like that day.
items.implication: Include booking clerks in the sample.

items.quote: Composite paraphrase: I was sent home at midnight and told to come back when they called; they called at six.
items.implication: Consider birth partners' accounts as part of women's interviews.

summary: Four composite voices across women, staff and the booking chain.
